**What now exists:** the membership types (\\u0060SolutionMembership\\u0060, \\u0060SolutionMember\\u0060, \\u0060SolutionState\\u0060) and the \\u0060Solution\\u0060 team field on \\u0060ProjectSettingsChanged\\u0060, \\u0060ProjectTeamSettingsChanged\\u0060, the aggregate and \\u0060ProjectDetails\\u0060. Also \\u0060SolutionDecider\\u0060, \\u0060SolutionRegistry\\u0060, the seven \\u0060h9k solution\\u0060 commands, \\u0060--solution\\u0060 on \\u0060task list\\u0060 and \\u0060epic list\\u0060, and a Solution row in \\u0060project show\\u0060. Write verbs are refused to dispatched sessions and \\u0060show\\u0060/\\u0060list\\u0060 are read-only there. \\u0060docs/concepts.md\\u0060, \\u0060docs/cli.md\\u0060, \\u0060docs/scope.md\\u0060 and the \\u0060hall9k-cli-reference\\u0060 skill are updated.\\n- **For solution epics, the solution window and onboarding:**\\n  - A solution is read, never loaded: use \\u0060SolutionRegistry.Read(projects)\\u0060, which picks the freshest copy by the \\u0060Solution\\u0060 team stamp. Members are keyed by project key, and \\u0060SolutionDecider.HeldProject\\u0060 is the one \\u0022registered and joined here\\u0022 lookup.\\n  - Anything that writes a solution should go through \\u0060SolutionWriter\\u0060 (\\u0060AppendAsync\\u0060 is the store-only half, used by \\u0060SolutionWriterTests\\u0060). It fences each stream and commits every member in one transaction.\\n  - The solution home in the window card should be named from \\u0060Membership.Name\\u0060.\\n  - \\u0060h9k project add --repo-url\\u0060 is the only way a project gets a repository URL; there is no setter, so \\u0060solution add\\u0060 refuses a project registered with only \\u0060--repo\\u0060, and the refusal says so.\\n- **Deliberately left undone:**\\n  - Two nodes linking one project into different solutions at the same moment resolve as last write wins; that is parked per the card.\\n  - There is no \\u0060reopen\\u0060: a closed solution is final, \\u0060link\\u0060 and \\u0060close\\u0060 refuse it, and \\u0060rename\\u0060 and \\u0060unlink\\u0060 still work.\\n  - Nothing in dispatch, delivery, review, closeout or the gh layer changed.\\n- **Verification:**\\n  - The non-Docker gate passed (9060 tests). The Docker-tagged \\u0060SolutionWriterTests\\u0060 and the new replication test in \\u0060EventReplicationTests\\u0060 were run on their own and passed; I did not run the whole Docker tier.\\n  - I ran \\u0060h9k solution add\\u0060 and \\u0060close\\u0060 without their required inputs and \\u0060solution list\\u0060, \\u0060show\\u0060 and \\u0060task list --solution\\u0060 with no solutions defined; the \\u0060add\\u0060/\\u0060close\\u0060 refusals and the \\u0022no solutions\\u0022 messages came out as written.
